head.h1: Pescatarian Catering in Dubai — Real Prices, Menus and Timings

opening_paragraph: Pescatarian catering in Dubai starts from AED 700 per person and delivers a seafood-and-vegetable menu — no meat — cooked fresh in your own space by a vetted chef. It leans on what the day-boats land: fish and shellfish, grilled, raw or gently cooked, with generous vegetables alongside. You send the date, guest count and venue; myCHEF matches a chef, designs the menu and we typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours, with a full itemised quote to follow. One team plans, cooks, serves and clears up, so the evening stays yours while the kitchen runs itself.

new_paragraphs: A pescatarian menu in Dubai is built around the catch and the season, then styled to your event. Popular building blocks include:
Raw & chilled: oysters, crudo, ceviche, tuna tartare, a chilled seafood tower.
From the grill: whole sea bream, king prawns, calamari, harissa-glazed octopus.
Mediterranean: seafood linguine, grilled halloumi, mezze, saffron seafood rice.
Asian: sushi and sashimi, miso-glazed cod, salt-and-pepper squid, laksa.
Vegetables & sides: heirloom-tomato salads, charred greens, roasted roots, grain bowls.
Dessert: a seasonal tart, chocolate fondant or a sorbet trio.
Every dish is agreed with you first, so the pescatarian food catering on the day reflects your taste, not a fixed template.

The raw bar is the reason this menu travels further than most. Because a chilled oyster and crudo counter carries no flame, no gas cylinder and no extraction requirement, it is one of the few live stations that goes anywhere in Dubai: a villa garden, a tower apartment where building rules bar every barbecue and grill from the balcony, or a yacht deck where no additional gas cylinder may come aboard. It stands on a beach too, where lighting a fire outside a designated zone is a Dubai Municipality offence and nothing fired is on the table. What it needs instead is shade, ice and a holding-temperature plan, which is a food-safety build rather than a permit. Where the grill section of the menu cannot run — on the boat, on the balcony — the fish is seared in the licensed partner kitchen and finished on an induction plancha beside the raw bar, so the menu above stays whole.

add_block.new_heading: Pescatarian catering for weddings, corporate and parties
new_paragraphs: The same seafood-led kitchen scales from an intimate dinner to a several-hundred-cover event. For weddings, a pescatarian menu suits coastal and garden settings beautifully — a raw bar on arrival, plated courses through dinner, a grazing display later. Corporate pescatarian catering in Dubai works for board lunches, DIFC client dinners and product launches where you want something lighter and more considered than the usual buffet. For pescatarian party catering — birthdays, pool days, villa gatherings — we lean into live stations and sharing platters that keep guests grazing. Pescatarian catering for events across Dubai also handles mixed-diet crowds gracefully: because the food is naturally free of meat, it slots alongside vegetarian, halal-conscious and gluten-free guests without a separate kitchen. Tell us the occasion and headcount and we shape the format to match.

new_paragraphs: Good seafood catering is as much about sourcing and safety as flavour. We favour responsibly caught and day-fresh fish, and we are candid when a species is out of season and a swap eats better. Allergens matter here more than most cuisines: shellfish and fish are common triggers, so every menu is annotated and the chef manages cross-contact in your kitchen. Nut-free, dairy-free and gluten-free adaptations are clear on request. For events with non-pescatarian guests, we can run a parallel vegetarian or meat option from the same service without slowing the pace. If a dish needs to be served raw — crudo, oysters, sashimi — it is held on ice and cut to order, not left standing. That attention is what separates a considered pescatarian catering company in Dubai from a reheated tray.

add_block.new_heading: How much does pescatarian catering cost in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: Pescatarian catering prices in Dubai start from AED 700 per person , and the format sets the rest. Buffet and drop-off styles sit lowest per guest; plated service with a chef and waiters sits higher, roughly AED 800–950 per head depending on the menu and the amount of premium seafood. Set catering packages run from AED 1,200 for smaller gatherings up to AED 5,500 for full-service occasions, and a chef's tasting is AED 1,400. The pescatarian catering cost moves with guest count, menu tier (day-boat fish versus lobster and oysters), service style and staffing. For affordable pescatarian catering you might choose a buffet with two hot stations; for luxury pescatarian catering, a plated raw-bar-to-dessert menu with dedicated service. See our Dubai catering price guide for worked examples, or send your details for an itemised quote.

Two questions usually arrive before the brief does, so here are straight answers. Is a few hundred dirhams a head enough for food in Dubai? For a delivered spread it often is; for a seafood table it usually is not, because this menu is priced by the catch, and oysters, lobster and day-boat fish are what carry it to the AED 700 mark. Say the number when you enquire and the chef designs to it or tells you plainly that it does not reach. And do the subscription boxes cover this? HelloFresh and the other kits do list pescatarian meals, and for two people cooking on a Tuesday they are a sensible answer — but a kit delivers ingredients and a recipe card, while a personal chef delivers the shopping, the cooking, the service and a clean kitchen at the end of it. If what you want is pescatarian meals cooked for you week to week rather than for one occasion, our weekly meal prep is the closer fit.

new_paragraphs: How much does pescatarian catering cost in Dubai?

Pescatarian catering costs from around AED 700 per person, quoted to your guest count, menu and service. Buffet and drop-off formats cost less per head than plated service with staff; premium seafood such as lobster and oysters raises the tier.
What's included in pescatarian catering?
Included is menu design, an optional tasting, a vetted chef cooking on site, service staff where needed, plating, setup and full cleanup. One team handles the event end to end.
What food is served at pescatarian catering?
Served is fresh fish and seafood with no meat — raw bar and crudo, grilled fish and shellfish, Mediterranean and Asian dishes, vegetable sides and dessert. Every menu is agreed with you first.
Can you cater a mixed-diet event with non-pescatarian guests?
Yes. Because the menu is naturally meat-free, it suits vegetarian and gluten-free guests, and we can run a parallel meat or vegetarian option from the same service without slowing the pace.
Do you offer pescatarian catering for weddings and corporate events?
We do — from plated wedding menus and raw bars to corporate pescatarian catering for board lunches, client dinners and launches, scaled from an intimate dinner to several hundred covers.
How do I book pescatarian catering in Dubai?
Booking is clear: share your date, guest count and venue, and we match a vetted chef and send an itemised proposal, usually within one business day.
Is the seafood fresh and food-safe?
Yes — we favour day-fresh, responsibly sourced fish, keep raw items on ice and cut to order, and work within Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .
